selection.rationale: Strategy-local MACE relaxation outcomes show a sharp size-tier convergence boundary: tiers 4 and 8 achieved 100% convergence (12/12) and tier 16 achieved 87.5% convergence (14/16) with 100% distinct final geometry hashes, whereas tier 32 achieved only 10% convergence (2/20, exclusively on bounded-strain actions a5236ad683fcb00b and 2ff52c5c06384277) and tier 64 achieved 0% convergence (0/16). We therefore concentrate 57 of 64 allocations on tiers 16 (37) and 8 (20) across all four compositions (CrMnFeCoNi, Cr2MnFeCoNi, CrMn2FeCoNi, CrMnFe2CoNi) and all three perturbation modes (chemical disorder, substitutional ordering, bounded strain), avoiding nonconvergent Cr2MnFeCoNi tier-16 substitutional ordering (7dd0fbff30845fcd) while sampling untested tier-4 (4 counts) and tier-8 actions. Tiers 32 (2 counts on the two partially converging bounded-strain actions) and 64 (1 count on e703932025955340, which had the lowest RMS displacement in tier 64) are held near minimum tier requirements to preserve converged structural yield.
